items.title: Ira Gitler interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: So he was always one of my heroes.

ctx.x: What are you going to do, tell him to go home?

No way. And he was like the core of that rhythm section, which they call the All- American Rhythm Section, and it was. So he was the constant. He went from the original band to the sextet, octet, whatever it happened to be at the time, and then the new band, which of course is where Joe Williams comes in.
That’s where I was going, that’s where I was going next. Talk to us about Joe as a singer, as a cultural icon as well.
